items.title: Matthew Stafford: Managing arm soreness
items.text:
Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Charger with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: More competition for work
items.text:
Wilson is welcoming back Zach Charbonnet (knee) and Jadarian Price (chest) to the Seahawks backfield for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Out for season
items.text:
Bourne suffered a fractured right tibia during Sunday's overtime win at Dallas that won't require surgery but will sideline him for three months, ending his 2026 season, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Expected to miss rest of season
items.text:
Bourne (ankle) is expected to miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reports.

items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling: Progressing in recovery
items.text:
Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.
